text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, I caught sight of 
Ryoka Tsurugi.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
――Well then, we look forward to working 
with you for next weekend's photoshoot 
starting at 10:00.

text_block_list.name: Sporting Goods Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine, I'm looking forward 
to it! Please give Elfie my regards as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much. Please excuse 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzt, bzzt)

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
――Yes... Elfie? What's the matter? Ah... 
you mean this week's video.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the editing is already done. Now all 
that's left is to encode and upload it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I'll send over the shooting schedule for 
next weekend after this, so please check 
it over. ...Yes, see you then.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what's left is... Buying 
merchandise we can use for the new 
project.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Trainer. What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ryoka Tsurugi called out to me, so we 
decided to take the opportunity to grab 
some tea together.
choice_data_list: Are you here for work today?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To greet the shops we'll be visiting 
for filming. And then to go shopping for 
items needed for the project――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of drafting the proposal 
and schedule for our new event right here.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't even count as busy yet! Above 
all, it's just so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Would you mind sharing your 
opinion, Trainer? Consider it part of my 
market research.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
What kind of videos do you usually watch, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
A cooking video for well-balanced, 
nutritious recipes
A video of a theme park.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Is that really... for <chrname>'s sake?
choice_data_list:
Yes, because it's knowledge essential for 
conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
To think you even check cooking videos... 
Hehe, well, it certainly is better if it 
tastes delicious.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should try posting a cooking 
video too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Ryoka Tsurugi flipped open her 
laptop and began typing away immediately.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: A theme park... Oh, is it to unwind?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's true that making good use of 
your days off helps you be more productive 
at work.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ryoka Tsurugi picked up the mug of coffee 
and took a satisfying sip.
